lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，贴着地面走。
lines.en: I come up from the soil and crawl close to it.

lines.zh: 电光在花心里聚了一下。
lines.en: A spark gathers in my flower heart.

lines.zh: 我爬得比看起来快得多。
lines.en: I crawl far faster than I look.
I raise a line along the soil as I go.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的地很硬，我只能贴地。
lines.en: Shyrelands' ground is hard; I must hug it.

lines.zh: 我只有一点生命，得走快点。
lines.en: One point of life means I must move fast.
My body is less than a block wide.
My scales scrape stone and throw sparks.

lines.zh: 前面有影子，我先钻下去。
lines.en: A shadow ahead; I dig down first.
I move along the roots of the grass.
An arc jumps along my back.

lines.zh: 我走得歪歪扭扭，像根藤。
lines.en: I go crooked like a climbing vine.
The ground is where I hide.

lines.zh: 快到了，那片阴影够我躲。
lines.en: Almost there; that shade will hide me.

lines.zh: 我从草根底下钻过去，土没动。
lines.en: I slip under the grass roots without moving soil.

lines.zh: 电在我背上跳，我不敢停。
lines.en: Sparks skip on my back and I can't stop.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进土里，只留花心。
lines.en: I bury myself, leaving only my flower heart out.
When the wind blows, my petals quiver.

lines.zh: 捕食者从上面走过，没看见我。
lines.en: A predator walked over and never saw me.

lines.zh: 这点电弧，是我全部的力气。
lines.en: This little arc is all the strength I have.
I look like a flower, but I am not one.

lines.zh: 我在等土里的虫子靠近。
lines.en: I wait for insects in the soil to come near.
A single point of life is far too brittle.
I pull my head back a little.
The days in Shyrelands run long.
The soil's cool seeps through my body.
My flower heart blinks on and off.
Don't step on me; I discharge.

lines.zh: 你低头看花，我就有机会。
lines.en: You bend to look at flowers; that's my chance.
You've taken me for a plant.
My petals open and close at you.
You crouch down, close to the soil.
Don't reach; my sparks don't aim.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里，高得望不到顶。
lines.en: You tower so high I can't see the top.

lines.zh: 你脚边就是我藏身的地方。
lines.en: You're standing on my hiding place.
So close — what are you looking at?
I blink my flower heart once.

lines.zh: 你退开吧，我不想先动手。
lines.en: Step back; I'd rather not start.
My petals have been crushed.

lines.zh: 这一下差点要了我的命。
lines.en: That nearly ended my one point of life.
I sink into the soil with only a tip showing.
The pain scrambled my spark.
You hit hard. I'm only a worm.
I spring away, smoking.
Please don't step on me a second time.
My single point of life is trembling.
Soil is my only way out.
I've hidden. Go away.

lines.zh: 你对一朵花晃食物，真奇怪。
lines.en: Waving food at a flower is strange of you.

lines.zh: 我吃小虫，不吃你手里的。
lines.en: I eat small insects, not what you hold.
That sweetness makes me itch.
Come closer and let me smell it.
My petals open from habit, nothing more.

lines.zh: 你的手别抖，我会扑上去。
lines.en: Don't shake your hand, or I'll lunge.

lines.zh: 土里的东西才合我胃口。
lines.en: What's in the soil suits my appetite.
This isn't bait. It's a trap, isn't it?
Let me circle it once first.
One whiff and I forget to hide.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩在我的花边上。
lines.en: You stepped on the edge of my flower.

lines.zh: 我贴地爬，很容易被踢到。
lines.en: Crawling low, I'm easy to kick.
Don't crush me; I'm very thin.
One knock and I bounce back half a block.
I slipped out from under your boot.
That weight can't pin me down.

lines.zh: 你踩到了土，我就在土里。
lines.en: You stepped on soil, and I'm in the soil.
I spring up and my spark flashes.
Move aside; I'm going back underground.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，你麻了吗？
lines.en: We touched. Did that numb you?

lines.zh: 花开的时候，我只是在装。
lines.en: When I bloom, I'm only pretending.
Worm matters have nothing to do with flowers.

lines.zh: 我在土里找同伴，不在地上。
lines.en: I find kin underground, not above it.
That business is settled deep down.
I can't even guard myself.

lines.zh: 同类见面，先比谁的电亮。
lines.en: When kin meet, we compare sparks.

lines.zh: 现在不是时候，有人来了。
lines.en: Not now. Someone is coming.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣藏在更深的土里。
lines.en: My mate hides deeper in the soil.
Don't look at me; I'm only a worm.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的土里，我们各自活。
lines.en: In Shyrelands' soil, each of us lives alone.

lines.zh: 地上有块腐肉，我拖进土里。
lines.en: Rotten flesh on the ground; I drag it under.
I pinch it with my petals.
This much will feed me a while.
I bite down and back away slowly.
Any insect that falls is mine.
That thing glows. Dangerous.

lines.zh: 我用花瓣卷住它，试了试分量。
lines.en: I curl a petal around it and test the weight.
Whatever's buried in the soil is mine.
I'm too small to drag anything larger.
Hide it first; eat it later.
Something is walking on the grass.
My petals turn toward the sound.
That heat is getting closer.

lines.zh: 脚底下的震动，我感觉得到。
lines.en: I can feel the shaking underfoot.
Fourteen points of current will do.
I fix on that insect that landed.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了枯叶，我听见了。
lines.en: You crushed a dead leaf; I heard it.

lines.zh: 影子罩住我，是猎物还是天敌？
lines.en: A shadow covers me. Prey or predator?
I'll flash once, as a warning.
From here I can reach you.
The soil moves. It's you.
I've chosen you. Don't move.
I circle right at your feet.
One step from you, one inch from me.
My charge is building. Almost full.

lines.zh: 你低头找我的时候最好。
lines.en: The best moment is when you look down for me.
I slip behind your shadow.
Don't hurry off; let me get closer.

lines.zh: 我的花心对着你的脚后跟。
lines.en: My flower heart aims at your heel.
This time I won't dig. I'll try.
You retreat, and I edge forward.
My flower heart faces you, always lit.

lines.zh: 我等一个你停下的瞬间。
lines.en: I wait for the instant you stop.

lines.zh: 你脚下这片土，都归我管。
lines.en: This patch of soil beneath you answers to me.

lines.zh: 电从我身上跳到你腿上。
lines.en: The spark leaps from me to your leg.
Fourteen points. That hurt, didn't it?
The petal touches, and only then the spark.
My flower heart touches you, then discharges.
Your leg twitched once, then went numb.
I spring up and strike you again.
The flash is brief but vicious.
Don't kick me; I'll come again.
I bite into your trouser cuff.
This single point of life, I stake it all.
A flower pushes up out of the soil.
I break the surface and shake off dirt.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的草地多了一个花苞。
lines.en: One more bud on the Shyrelands grass.

lines.zh: 电在我身体里响了一声。
lines.en: A spark crackles inside my body.
One point of life is enough to move a long while.
I pose as a plant and wait for someone.
The soil loosened, and out I came.
The flower heart lights first, then the rest of me.
Who carried a seed to this place?
I try to stand straight; my stem is soft.
My petals curl the moment they burn.

lines.zh: 从半空掉下来，花梗折了。
lines.en: Dropping from the air bent my stem.

lines.zh: 水灌进土里，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water fills the soil and I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 气浪把土和花一起掀了。
lines.en: The blast threw up soil and flower together.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉住了我的花心。
lines.en: An arrow has pinned my flower heart.
The spell pressed down and my charge went out.
It has been long since I ate an insect.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，全是熟悉的麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck; the numbness was familiar.

lines.zh: 掉出地面，我连土都没有。
lines.en: Falling out of the ground, I have no soil.
